title: Character, Creature, Token, Portrait & Cast Presentation Binding
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Character, Creature, Token, Portrait and Cast Presentation Binding over the MAS-01..11 foundations while preserving canonical Character/Creature, MCCS/entity-presentation, token/portrait/media and runtime owner authority and keeping presentation bindings distinct from canonical entity or live runtime mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Character, Creature, Token, Portrait and Cast Presentation bindings inside the MAS workspace without turning presentation bindings into canonical entity, media, token or live runtime mutation.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically bind prepared Character, Creature, Token, Portrait and Cast presentation references over the completed MAS foundations with explicit references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical owner/runtime authority and never treating presentation bindings as executed live truth.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-11 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

Character, Creature, Token, Portrait and Cast presentation structures remain prepared binding semantics only; Character/Creature owners retain canonical entity state, MCCS/CAPP/entity-presentation owners retain presentation state, ARI/MAI retains media identity/provenance/rights/interoperability, and Action/Event/runtime owners retain live truth and mutation.
Prepared presentation bindings never prove canonical entity mutation, presentation mutation, media mutation, token placement/runtime state or live presentation truth.

MAS-12 consumed explicit MAS-11 prepared references plus validated Character/Creature/Presentation owner bindings and explicit ARI-style token/portrait media references; unresolved references fail closed.
MAS-12 introduced no parallel Character/Creature store, entity-presentation store, media library, token-placement runtime, portrait renderer or Action/Event outcome ledger.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-12.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-12, including current MSLR planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-13 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-14+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-12 is closed. MAS-13 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
